tasks.title: Implement check stage loop with SHA snapshot and CheckSuite persistence
tasks.description: Rewrite WorkflowController.runPipelineCheckStage() to: (1) create CheckSuite with snapshotSha=HEAD on entry, (2) loop up to maxRetries=3 executing build-test then ai-review sequentially, (3) persist each check state change to DB via CheckSuiteRepo, (4) on check failure run auto-fix agent, (5) if auto-fix produces new commit (SHA changed) update snapshotSha and restart loop, (6) if SHA unchanged count as failed attempt. Add helper to read HEAD SHA via git rev-parse. Emit check_suite_status_changed on suite status transitions. On max retries exhausted return escalateToStage=Stage.Plan.
acceptanceCriteria: CheckSuite created with snapshotSha on check stage entry
Each check state (pending→running→passed/failed) persisted to DB
Loop retries up to 3 times on failure with auto-fix
SHA unchanged after auto-fix counts as failed attempt
All checks pass → suite status 'awaiting-approval', requiresApproval=true
Max retries exhausted → suite status 'failed', success=false, escalateToStage=Plan
check_suite_status_changed event emitted on status transitions
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: Keep existing runBuildTestCheck and runAiReviewCheck internal methods. Add outer loop wrapper that coordinates them. For ai-review auto-fix, spawn a coder agent with fix prompt similar to spawnBuildTestFixAgent. Read HEAD SHA via execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']) in worktree dir.

Include checkSuite field in GET /api/issues/:number response.
